function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Retrieves the history and context for a customer based on their phone number. Call this at the start of every conversation to see if they are a returning caller.

tenant_id.description: The unique ID for the business (tenant).

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Checks if a specific time slot is available for booking.

resource_id.description: The ID of the truck or person to book.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Books an appointment in the calendar. Always check availability first.

description.description: What the appointment is for (e.g., 'Flat tire repair').

call_id.description: Pass the 'call.id' from the conversation context.
